spans.s: Koṭiśa, a serpent. § 63 (Sarpasattra): I, 57, 2146 (of Vāsuki's race).

Koṭikāsya, a prince, follower of Jayadratha. § 522 (Draupadīharaṇap.): III, 264, 15582 (rājānaṃ), 15587; 265, (†15588), †15593 (Surathasya putraḥ); 266, 15605 (Surathasya putraṃ); 267, 15612; 271, 15720, 15739 (is slain by Bhīmasena). Cf. Koṭika.

Koṭitīrtha, name of various tīrthas. § 358 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 82, 4091 (Mahākālaṃ tato gacchen niyato niyatāśanaḥ| Kºm upaspṛśya hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet).--§ 362 (do.): III, 83, 5087 (tataḥ Pañcanadaṃ gatvā niyataḥ niyatāśanaḥ| Kºm upaspṛśya hayamedhaphalaṃ).--§ 370 (do.): III, 83, 7071 (abhivādya tato Yakshaṃ dvārapālaṃ Macakrukaṃ | Kºm upaspṛśya labhed bahusuvarṇakaṃ).--§ 370 (do.): III, 84, 8005 (tatrābhishekaṃ kurvīta--i.e. at Gaṅgādvāra--Kºe samāhitaḥ|puṇḍarīkam avāpnoti kulañ caiva samuddhāret), 8055 (ºe naraḥ snātvā arcayitvā Guhaṃ nṛpa | gosahasraphalaṃ vindyāt tejasvī ca bhaven naraḥ).--§ 372 (do.): III, 85, 8204 (ºe naraḥ snātvā gosahasraphalaṃ labhet).
